He later returned all money and got forgiveness. This is misappropriation of public funds? Actually it's "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds). The lexicon includes "挪用公款". However "挪用公款" is defined as misappropriation of public funds (state funds). Here it's private company funds. Could be "侵占" (occupation/appropriation). Lexicon includes "侵占". Also "诈骗" maybe? He didn't deceive to get money? He used his position to take money that was supposed to go to the company; that's embezzlement. In Chinese criminal law, "挪用公款罪" applies to public funds. For private funds, "职务侵占罪" (occupying company funds) is "侵占". The lexicon includes "侵占". So likely charge is "侵占". Also maybe "玩忽职守"? He abused his duty, but the specific crime is "职务侵占". So "侵占" is correct.
